title: Hermes House Admission
objective: Adapt and admit the qualified minimum Hermes resident as a pure provider-neutral communications contract kernel without live channels, storage backend, credential resolution, mutation execution, second authority, or duplicate orchestration.
laws: Hermes is infrastructure, not a Titan.
Trust Canal remains the only consequential admission/authority boundary.
Work remains orchestration truth and Talos remains execution verification/retry truth.
Keymaster owns credential semantics; Hermes carries no raw secrets or credential locators.
No ACK may be claimed without explicit durable receipt evidence.
Processing lifecycle and delivery lifecycle remain distinct.
Channel bindings are default-deny and provider-neutral.
PandaOS is copied for useful experience patterns only; its backend is not duplicated.
